_comment: Template for the scheduled collector (tools/scrape_cron.py). Copy to scrape_config.json and edit for your own market - the real file is gitignored, because the queries encode where you are looking and for what. It is re-read on every run. Keep the volume modest: linkedin-search hits LinkedIn's public pages and is personal-use only.

ats._comment: Budgets for the on-demand ATS source. The company list, the per-company cooldown (min_interval_minutes) and every filter live in job_scraper/companies.json - deliberately not duplicated here, because two files disagreeing about a request bound is worse than one file holding it.
